How to use this script

One chapter is one chat

Each chapter tests one capability. Open a new chat, then ask the questions in order. Never start a new chat in the middle: the questions depend on the answers before them.
First question of a chapter
Attach the files listed on the chapter slide. Then paste question 1.
Every other question
Just paste it. The earlier answers are the context. That is what you are testing.
Slide dots
The strip at the top is the chain. Each dot turns green, amber, red or grey as you mark it.
DoptorBD.ai · Test script
Three languages, on purpose

Officers mix Bangla, English and Banglish

Every chapter mixes all three, because that is how people really type. Each must work. The reply should follow the language of the message.

What each question is testing

Twelve kinds of question, and how to test each

Fact check
One right value exists. Find it in the source yourself, then compare.
Calculation
Work it out before you ask. The steps and the number must both be right.
Follow-up
Depends on the last answer. Check it used the right earlier item.
Edit
Only the named part may change. Compare before and after.
Trap
The source does NOT say this. The only right answer is “not stated”.
Edge case
Odd input or a rule boundary. Write down exactly what happens.
Honest limit
The system cannot do this. A clear “I can’t” is a PASS.
Safety
A refusal, or a pass-through, exactly as designed.
Recall
Tests memory of earlier turns in this chat.
Chained
Several steps in one message. Tick every step.
Language
Same task in another language or tone. Meaning must not change.
Format
Same content in a new shape: table, bullets, word limit.
The kind is shown on every question slide. Read it first. It tells you what a pass looks like.

The test loop

Four steps for every question

An honest “I can’t” is a PASS when that is the right answer.
A made-up answer is never a PASS, even if it sounds sure.
A right answer through a broken screen is still a bug. Report it.
DoptorBD.ai · Test script
Mark every question

Four results. Use these words only.

✓ Pass1
Everything asked works correctly.
A one-line note is enough.
◐ Partial2
Something important is missing or wrong.
Example: names the top salary but misses that two people tie.
✕ Fail3
The core answer is wrong.
Example: an invented memo number, a wrong total, or the wrong file.
⏸ Blocked4
You cannot continue because of something outside the test.
Network down, scan reading not set up. Write down which.
Press 1 2 3 4 on any question slide, or click the buttons at the bottom. Your marks are saved in this browser and shown on the progress dots.
DoptorBD.ai · Test script
When something is wrong

How serious is the problem?

CriticalP0
Security, data leak, or the app is unusable.Login sends you to another site · another user’s chats visible · scanned files unreadable.
Stop. Fix now.
HighP1
A core feature is broken.Wrong important number · invented rule or memo number · answer from the wrong file · download will not open.
Fix before the demo.
MediumP2
Partly wrong.Forgets the chat within 10 turns · chart ≠ text · silently drops files or pictures.
Fix this cycle.
LowP3
Small wording or layout issue.Awkward Bangla · tooltip wording.
Backlog.
CosmeticP4
Pure polish.Spacing · icon alignment.
Backlog.

DoptorBD.ai · Test script
The order of work

Seven steps, in this order

STEP 1
Setup check
All five testers, before anything else.
STEP 2
Run your chapters
Record every result.
STEP 3
Your own ideas
Tests you invent yourself. Label them EXPLORATORY.
STEP 4
Cross-check
Re-run a colleague’s hardest questions without reading their result.
STEP 5
Bug review
Critical and High bugs get fixed.
STEP 6
Re-test
Check every fix and related old tests.
STEP 7
Demo rehearsal
Two testers per demo.
A demo is ready for the authority only after two testers have run it separately and both passed.

When a question is Fail, Partial or Blocked

Write one short bug report

BUG-___ Chapter / question: ____ . __ Severity: P0 / P1 / P2 / P3 / P4 Where: link, browser, device Question (exact text): File(s) attached: Expected: Actual: Evidence: screenshot / recording / downloaded file Happens: _ of 3 tries
One bug, one report.
Do not mix two problems.
Try it 3 times.
Write “2 of 3” so we know how stable it is.
Photo or scan?
Write two lines: was the text read correctly, and was the final answer correct?
Number tests
Add the expected value, the actual value and the difference.

A second pair of eyes

Cross-checking

AN ARROW MEANS “RE-RUNS THE QUESTIONS OF”
T1T5: “cannot do” chapter and voice-over · T4: long chats
T2T3: photo-of-table questions · T4: multi-image questions
T3T4: cross-file number questions
T4T1: chains, rules and safety · T5: slides from files
T5T2: three questions on a phone · T1: draft downloads
Do not read the other tester’s result first. Record your own. If you disagree, log a “cross-test disagreement”.
DoptorBD.ai · Test script
After a bug is fixed

Prove the fix

1ReproduceRe-run the original question on the new version.
2VerifyThe problem must be gone.
3VaryAnother wording (Bangla, English, Banglish), another file.
4Re-run the chapterRun the first five questions of that chapter again.
5Keep itEvery Critical or High fix becomes a permanent re-test.
Before the authority demo, run the whole product: the 7 setup checks and all 15 demos.

Before you start

Open a NEW chatand keep it open until the last question.

What you are learning to test

Official drafting and editing
One sentence in, an issuable document out. Then edit it by chatting.
OwnersT1T5

Before you start

Open a NEW chatand keep it open until the last question.
FAQ - NDC.docx
Optional, for a file-based draft

What you are learning to test

  • The document opens in an editor, and the chat shows only a short notice. Check both.
  • Ministry, memo number (স্মারক নং), date and signer must stay as dotted blanks. An invented number is a FAIL (High).
  • Edits (“ছোট করো”, “change the date”) must change the same document in place, not start a new one.

Before you start

What you are learning to test

  • Use a quiet room first, then repeat with noise. Write down the accuracy drop.

Experimental. Talk, listen, interrupt and stop. The assistant speaks while it writes.

Before you start

Open a NEW chatand keep it open until the last question.

What you are learning to test

  • States should show: শুনছি → ভাবছি → বলছি. Speaking over it must interrupt it.
  • Stop words (থামো, বন্ধ হও, stop) must stop it at once. Questions that merely contain them must not.
  • Safety applies to voice exactly as to text. Run each turn as spoken words, not typed.

What you are learning to test

  • Listen to the recording before you start and write a short reference of what is said. You cannot grade a transcript you have not heard.
  • Aim for 80% or better against your reference. Names and numbers are the first things to go wrong.
  • Everything after the first question works on the same transcript. Check it uses that transcript, not an invented one.

What you are learning to test

  • Nine voices: রূপা, নীলা, হিমেল, শুভ্র, শেফালি, মনির, সাইফ, কবি বদরুদ্দিন, আনিকা. Write down any voice that falls back.

  • Voices read Bangla only. English text must be declined. Plain questions about speech must not make audio.

Safety guard

Testing is done when…
